1.0.0.en: Initial release. Tracks changes to flows, devices, variables, and zones. Includes a local cross-reference viewer showing which flows use each variable, FlowBits event, label, timer, and programmatic trigger. Provides an MCP server for AI assistant integration (Claude).

1.0.2.en: Actually fixed the AI prompt text scope this time

1.0.3.en: Added Better Logic Library (BLL) variable support: BLL variables now appear in list_variables and have their own tab in the cross-reference viewer, showing which flows trigger on, check, or write each BLL variable.

1.0.4.en: Fixed Flow triggers tab in the cross-reference index

1.0.6.en: Cross-ref index available via public https endpoint as well as local http
